name: Katarzyna Nowak
bio:
Katarzyna's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for electronics and a deep interest in Formula 1. After graduating with honors in electrical engineering from Warsaw University of Technology, she honed her skills working on advanced control systems for industrial machinery. Her passion for racing led her to pursue opportunities in motorsport, initially volunteering with smaller racing teams before securing a position with a leading engine manufacturer. 

At Scuderia Ferrari, Katarzyna specializes in the intricate electronics that power the modern F1 car, from engine management to data acquisition. She is known for her methodical approach to problem-solving and her ability to quickly identify and resolve complex electrical issues. Her experience and unflinching commitment make her a valuable asset in the high-pressure environment of Formula 1. She believes in constant self-improvement and strives to implement innovative solutions to gain a competitive advantage on the track.
